rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that continues for a long time, especially beliefs, relationships, or situations.

example.english: They have maintained an enduring friendship.
example.traditional: 佢哋維持咗一段長久嘅友誼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 wai4 ci4 zo2 jat1 dyun6 coeng4 gau2 ge3 jau5 ji4

rows.note: Use this for physical objects that remain usable for a long time without wearing out.

example.english: This pot is truly enduring; even after all these years of use, it’s still in great shape.
example.traditional: 呢個煲真係好耐用，用咗咁多年仲好好。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bou1 zan1 hai6 hou2 noi6 jung6 jung6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4 zung6 hou2 hou2

rows.note: Use this more formal choice for effects, strength, influence, or conditions that continue over time.

example.english: This medicine has an enduring effect, so one dose lasts a long time.
example.traditional: 呢種藥效好持久，食一次可以頂好耐。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 joek6 haau6 hou2 ci4 gau2 sik6 jat1 ci3 ho2 ji5 ding2 hou2 noi6
